parts.name: M8 x 1.25 SHCS Bolt Assembly with Self-Aligning Slide-In T-Nut, 18.00mm
parts.description: Bolt assembly made of one 11-8518 M8 x 1.25 socket head cap screw (SHCS), 18.00mm long, and one 13025 Self-Aligning Slide-In T-Nut. No washer is included.
parts.notes: Listed in the table "M8 x 1.25 Socket Head Cap Screw (SHCS)" under Bolt Assemblies (Continued). Series inferred from thread size; the Bolt Assemblies tables have no series badge.

page_notes.355: Bolt Assemblies (Continued), M8 x 1.25 SHCS table only (no 5/16-18 rows); extracted only 75-3627, the one assembly number in the WANTED list.
page_notes.356: Bolt Assemblies (Continued), M4 x 0.7 and M5 x 0.8 BHSCS/FHSCS/SHCS tables (no 5/16-18 rows); no assembly number on this page is in the WANTED list, so nothing extracted.

remaining_doubts: Several WANTED numbers appear on these pages only as components inside assembly rows, not as assembly numbers: 11-8512 (bolt in 75-3624, 75-3530, 75-3620) and 11-6042 (washer in 75-3534, 75-3535, 75-3536) on p355; 11-4312 (75-3538), 11-4512 (75-3563), 11-4710 (75-3552), 11-5312 (75-3539, 75-3583), 11-5314 (75-3576), 11-5316 (75-3540), 11-5516 (75-3483), 11-5716 (75-3575), 13-5516 (75-3400), 13-6040 (75-3400) and 25-1941 (75-3537) on p356. The pages give no definitions for them, so they were not extracted; the assemblies that contain them are metric and not wanted.
